name: focusdesk-96
description: FocusDesk 96 — a Windows 95-style study and productivity desktop, as a native app for macOS, Windows and Linux.

scripts.prebuild: node scripts/check-ascii.js && node scripts/build-icon.js && node scripts/vendor-katex.js
scripts.prebuild:mac: node scripts/check-ascii.js && node scripts/build-icon.js && node scripts/vendor-katex.js && node scripts/build-mac-helper.js
scripts.prebuild:win: node scripts/check-ascii.js && node scripts/build-icon.js && node scripts/vendor-katex.js
scripts.prebuild:linux: node scripts/check-ascii.js && node scripts/build-icon.js && node scripts/vendor-katex.js

extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: FocusDesk 96 reads the current song and sends play, pause and skip to Spotify or Music for its Now Playing pill.
extendInfo.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: FocusDesk 96 reads your Apple Calendar events so they can appear in its own calendar. It never changes them.
extendInfo.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: FocusDesk 96 reads your Apple Calendar events so they can appear in its own calendar. It never changes them.
extendInfo.NSRemindersUsageDescription: FocusDesk 96 reads your Apple Reminders so they can appear in its Tasks. It never changes them.
extendInfo.NSRemindersFullAccessUsageDescription: FocusDesk 96 reads your Apple Reminders so they can appear in its Tasks. It never changes them.
